title: RAF pilots encounter Aurora over the North Sea

tellings.quote: he had talked to pilots who had encountered the Aurora in the North Sea

plain: Nick Cook, a writer on secret aircraft and anti-gravity, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a man who had spoken with pilots from the RAF, Britain's Royal Air Force. According to Cook, those pilots said they had run into the Aurora, a rumoured secret high-speed aircraft, over the North Sea sometime in the late 1980s or 1990s. If true, it would mean such a craft was really flying.
